user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: User Administration: Validate Duplicate Username Prevention During User Creation
proposed_scenarios.description: Complete end-to-end test of the user creation workflow that validates the system correctly prevents creation of users with duplicate usernames by displaying appropriate error messages. This scenario covers navigation to user management, form population with all required fields, and verification of duplicate username validation behavior.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify that the system maintains data integrity by preventing duplicate usernames and provides clear, actionable error feedback to administrators attempting to create users with existing usernames
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As an HR Administrator, I want the system to prevent me from creating duplicate usernames so that each user has a unique identifier and the system maintains data integrity

detailed_steps.description: Load the OrangeHRM dashboard as the starting point for user administration workflow
detailed_steps.verification_point: Dashboard page loads successfully with authenticated session
detailed_steps.business_impact: Ensures administrator has proper access to begin user management tasks

detailed_steps.description: Click the Admin menu link to access system administration and user management features
detailed_steps.verification_point: System Users page loads showing existing user list
detailed_steps.business_impact: Provides access to user administration features where admins can view and manage system users

detailed_steps.description: Click the Add button to open the new user creation form
detailed_steps.verification_point: Add User form page loads with all required fields displayed
detailed_steps.business_impact: Initiates the user creation workflow allowing administrator to add new system users

detailed_steps.description: Click the User Role dropdown to display available role options
detailed_steps.business_impact: Allows administrator to select appropriate role for the new user (Admin or ESS)

detailed_steps.description: Select 'Admin' option from the User Role dropdown to assign administrator privileges
detailed_steps.business_impact: Defines user permissions and access level within the system

detailed_steps.action: Enter employee name in autocomplete field
detailed_steps.description: Type text into the Employee Name autocomplete field to trigger employee search
detailed_steps.business_impact: Links the system user account to an existing employee record in the database

detailed_steps.description: Select 'Aparna123 4Ys 010Z' from the employee autocomplete suggestions
detailed_steps.business_impact: Associates the new user account with specific employee details for complete user profile

detailed_steps.description: Click the Status dropdown to display available status options
detailed_steps.business_impact: Allows administrator to control whether the user account is immediately active

detailed_steps.description: Select 'Enabled' option from the Status dropdown to activate the user account
detailed_steps.business_impact: Determines whether the user can immediately log in after account creation

detailed_steps.description: Enter 'Admin' into the Username field - this is an existing username that should trigger duplicate validation error
detailed_steps.business_impact: Critical test point - entering duplicate username to verify system validation prevents duplicate user creation

detailed_steps.description: Enter 'Test@123' into the Password field to meet password requirements
detailed_steps.business_impact: Provides secure credentials for the new user account

detailed_steps.description: Enter 'Test@123' into the Confirm Password field to match the password
detailed_steps.business_impact: Validates password entry by requiring confirmation, reducing password entry errors

detailed_steps.description: Submit the user creation form by clicking the Save button to trigger validation
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page remains on Add User form and displays error message 'Already exists' below Username field, preventing duplicate user creation
detailed_steps.business_impact: Critical validation point - system correctly rejects duplicate username and provides clear error feedback to administrator

expected_results: Administrator successfully navigates to Add User form through Admin menu
All required form fields are populated with valid data except duplicate username
Form submission is attempted by clicking Save button
System detects duplicate username 'Admin' and prevents user creation
Error message 'Already exists' is displayed below Username field
Form remains on Add User page without creating duplicate user account
Data integrity is maintained - no duplicate usernames exist in system
edge_cases_to_test: Username validation with different case variations (Admin vs admin vs ADMIN)
Real-time validation feedback before form submission
Error message persistence and clearing behavior
Ability to correct username and successfully submit after error
data_requirements: Pre-existing username 'Admin' must exist in the system
Valid employee record 'Aparna123 4Ys 010Z' must exist for employee selection
Test credentials for authenticated admin access
Password that meets system password requirements (Test@123)
prerequisites: User must be authenticated as administrator with user management permissions
OrangeHRM system is accessible and functional
At least one existing user with username 'Admin' exists in the system
Employee records are available in the system for association
